body: feed, soap, and a clean jar, paid cash. my note below says saltlike grains came from the livestock supplement test; my sister coughed all night before warning tape went up.
title: cab receipt before sunday's rain
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the saltlike grains while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

title: Last fuel stop
body: At the bend they made us wait for a lead car before letting anyone through. The lead car never returned. The man who kept the count quietly drew a line through everyone still waiting when the road filled up.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
